comment: In-game BEFORE/AFTER for minimap camp-creep markers. Pin hero at corner 0, start minigame with bot_force, let it run ~16s so all 20 camp creeps recruit. Snap the minimap at t=6 (all idle, should show 80 hollow red rings across 4 corners) and t=20 (camp 0 recruited, should show ~20 owner-colored dots near the hero + remaining idle rings at other corners).
